description: Defines asynchronous execution utilities including awaitables for executing tasks on different executors, with support for try_execute_on, try_defer_to, and offloading tasks with continuation resumption.

classes.name: try_execute_on_awaiter
classes.description: Awaitable that attempts to execute a task on a given executor, returning success status.

classes.name: blocking_execute_on_awaiter
classes.description: Awaitable that blocks until a task is successfully dispatched to an executor.

classes.name: task_executor_offloader
classes.description: Awaitable that offloads a task to a dispatch executor and resumes in a resume executor, supporting void and non-void return types.

methods.name: try_execute_on
methods.description: Returns an awaitable that attempts to execute a task on a specified executor.

methods.name: try_defer_to
methods.description: Returns an awaitable that attempts to defer a task on a specified executor.

methods.name: try_offload_to_executor
methods.description: Offloads a task to a dispatch executor and resumes in a resume executor, supporting tasks with non-void return types.
